item.title: Cute Skeleton Just Bones and Unread Messages
item.description: A cute skeleton lies on its stomach scrolling its phone, nothing left but bones and a pile of unread messages. Great for introverts and the chronically online, and a funny gift. Available on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Calm Capybara Witch Introvert Halloween Vibes
item.description: A serene capybara in a tiny witch hat, eyes half closed, casting the only spell an introvert needs: peace and quiet. A funny gift for homebodies, witchy friends and capybara fans. Available on stickers, hoodies and mugs. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.

item.title: Tired Skeleton Bones Tired Spirit Also Tired
item.description: This little skeleton is lying flat and done for the day, because the bones are tired and the spirit is too. A cute, spooky gift for anyone running on empty. By OuqCreations on Redbubble.
